learning_outcomes.text: Acquaintance with the mechanics and energetics of the electrical drive.
Acquaintance with the electromechanical characteristics of the DC and AC electrical drive.
Acquaintance with different operating modes of electrical machines.
Receive practical and theoretical knowledge for different kinds of electrical drives and their application.

syllabus_topics: Electromechanics characteristics of the DC and induction electrical drive
Electrical drives with static power converter
assessment_rules: The exam is conducted in written form and consists of two subject questions.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Electrical Power Engineering (Bachelor)
